prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: complete standalone 1536 x 1024 landscape background plate for a 2.5D action game. Generate BRAND NEW independent environment artwork, not an edit, recolor, crop, rearrangement, or overlay of the reference. The input image is ONLY a reference for bright hand-painted children's fantasy style, warm cream ivory / pale honey stone palette, natural soft edges, overhead 3/4 near-isometric camera, and small irregular paving-stone scale. Match those aspects, invent the entire composition anew. Setting: colorful insect civilization of amber resin, translucent shells, fresh huge leaves, pollen flowers, rounded honeywax architecture. It is a sunny open valley, friendly, rich, luminous, no gloom.
CRITICAL game geometry: image coordinates use normalized x/y. The central playable hard dry floor must remain a single flat continuous clear dry stone surface throughout the polygon [(0.25,0.18),(0.45,0.105),(0.67,0.12),(0.82,0.19),(0.885,0.30),(0.90,0.60),(0.86,0.76),(0.71,0.87),(0.50,0.93),(0.30,0.87),(0.165,0.74),(0.12,0.56),(0.14,0.36),(0.205,0.24)]. The gameplay mapping rect is [0.11,0.13,0.78,0.74]; all high scenery, shrubs, buildings, pillars, furniture and water must be placed beyond that polygon and keep these floor coordinates clear. Clear ground should dominate about 75% of the image. Broad open dry pathways reach left/right frame edges near mid-height. No central lake, well opening, pit, canal, island gap, tree, wall, tower, roof, chair, stall, basket or flowerbed inside the playable polygon. No drawn objective, chest, enemy, person, creature, egg monster, HUD, UI, map icon, text, letter or watermark anywhere. Tiny flat moss seams and subtle color variations in paving are allowed. Every stone visually small; warm cream ground, not saturated yellow.
All outer scenery naturally supports the floor with roots and softly layered sloping banks. No rectangular floating slab, giant wall or rigid symmetric frame. Complete filled background right to every image edge, with distinctive outer ecological and architectural scene. The seven rooms must look visibly different because each scene has a different entire outer composition and environmental use.
ROOM ID: L10.
Scene/backdrop: Compose a sunlit giant-flower ventilation garden. All active architecture is in the extreme upper-left corner OUTSIDE playable polygon: a towering hollow lily-like flower with ivory-gold stamen chimney and purple-green petal blades acting as organic wind guides, its well opening safely completely outside floor. Upper-right edge features a distant series of thin amber resin branches sloping down toward valley, never a wall. Extreme lower-right corner is a layered dew shrub terrace with hanging dew beads and a curving pale petal bank. Extreme lower-left has broad green leaves leaning outward with violet undersides. A dynamic diagonal floral airflow composition, with the very large northwestern flower and lower-right dew garden; no village stalls, boats, nursery cottages, observatory pavilion, factories or metal fan. Floor uninterrupted and quiet with tiny pollen-tinted seams.
Output: one complete 1536 x 1024 landscape image, no text.
